description: This file defines the Autoloader class for the OpenCart system, responsible for automatically loading class files based on namespace registration and class names.

classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: Class responsible for dynamically loading PHP class files based on registered namespaces and directory mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Autoloader and registers the autoload function with SPL.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a namespace with a directory path, optionally using PSR-4 standard.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load a class file based on the class's namespace and registered search paths.
